# Linear-surrogate ceiling of the Gate (modeled; auto-generated by reports/linear_frontier.py)

Exact H2 results for the linearised corner-with-Gate (frame stage = k_b ∥ c_eq ∥ J r² inerter; no stops, no freewheeling). Grid: bias ratio 0.05–1.0 × OEM damper scale 1.0–0.1 × c_eq 30–30,000 N·s/m. r = 300 rad/m, J = 3e-05 kg m², guide friction 100 N·s/m, η = 0.85. Two optima per row: **max** = unconstrained maximum electrical power (and what it costs in ride and tire load); **ok** = maximum subject to sprung-acceleration RMS ≤ passive and dynamic tire-load RMS ≤ 1.1 × passive. P_net_ok subtracts friction and the mass penalty of the vehicle's gate_mass estimate at that speed.

Reading: the unconstrained maximum is reached by removing the OEM damper and letting the tire bounce (dtl +); it is not a design. The constrained optimum is the architecture's honest ceiling for small motions; the nonlinear sweeps (stops, freewheeling, inertance only when engaged) can only come in below it.
